name: Wairarapa and ZhuZhen Rural Landscape Perception (rating)
description: Faithful replication of the questionnaire in Chenfeng Wang (2025), "Culturally Grounded Perceptions of Rural Landscapes: A Cross-Cultural Analysis of ZhuZhen Town and the Wairarapa Region", PhD thesis, Victoria University of Wellington (Appendix C; Figures 32–33). The thesis compared how residents and visitors see the rural landscape of the Wairarapa (New Zealand, N=82) and of ZhuZhen Town (China, N=142). Participants first answer background questions: age, gender, resident or visitor, years lived or number of visits, ethnicity, education, and length and purpose of stay. They then rate 6 landscape-perception statements and 5 landscape-aesthetic statements from "Not at all" to "Completely" and make three top-3 choices (problems caused by visitors, words that describe the area, landscapes they enjoy most). Last, they rate 10 photographs of their area (valley, local architecture, roads, lake, bridge, sculpture, mountain ranges, farmland, local customs, wildlife) from "Strongly dislike" to "Strongly like". In the thesis, Wairarapa participants liked mountain ranges (4.72) and valleys (4.65) most and roads (2.94) least, while ZhuZhen ratings were close together (3.39–3.91). The page stores both tables of means. The 20 photographs were taken by the author and are used as published in the thesis, with credit. This template will be removed if the author objects. Differences from the original study: (1) a first question chooses the site version (Wairarapa or ZhuZhen Town), which in the original were two separate Qualtrics surveys; (2) the ZhuZhen version is shown in English, the language of the thesis appendix; (3) follow-up questions appear only when they apply (years lived for residents; visits, stay length and purpose for visitors); (4) the top-3 lists allow at most 3 choices and need at least one, and all questions are required, since the appendix does not say which were optional; (5) spelling in two answer options is corrected ("grazing", "Mountain ranges and valley"); (6) the photos were cropped from the thesis figures without their captions, and the ten photos for each site are shown on one page in the thesis order.

Two site versions: the Wairarapa (New Zealand) and ZhuZhen Town (China). Background questions, 6 landscape-perception statements (Not at all to Completely), 5 landscape-aesthetic statements, two top-3 choices, then 10 representative photographs of the site taken by the author rated from Strongly dislike (1) to Strongly like (5). Photo ratings are keyed by landscape element and the site folder.
